prompt: Institutional quantitative finance terminal SaaS — ultra-clean modern redesign preserving exact color palette: backgrounds #0A0A0C / #111115 / #18181E, borders #2A2A35, text #EAEAEA / #8A8A9A, primary accent orange #F97316 / #FF6B00, green #22C55E, red #EF4444, font JetBrains Mono monospace throughout. Layout: fixed narrow sidebar (nav links: Macro View, ML Alpha, Screener, Scorer, Portfolio, Equity Ov., Reporting, Settings, Account) + sticky top ticker bar showing live market data (S&P 500, VIX, US 10Y, Gold, Oil) + main content area. Design priorities: generous whitespace, strong visual hierarchy, crisp data-dense tables with subtle row separations, metric cards with clean stat blocks, smooth micro-animations on hover, minimal chrome, razor-sharp typography scale. Sidebar: slim icon+label nav items, subtle active state with orange left-border accent, no heavy backgrounds. Top bar: minimal inline ticker with delta indicators. Content: modular card grid, clean section headers, elegant data tables. Feel: Bloomberg meets Linear — institutional rigor with modern product polish. No gradients except very subtle card depth. No decorative elements.
